selected_spans.text: One kilowatt is equal to 1,000 Watts.

For very large amounts of electricity, like what power plants generate, we use even larger units:
Megawatts (MW): One MW is 1,000 kW, or 1,000,000 Watts.

preliminary data
1
Utility-scale electricity generation is electricity generation from power plants with at least one megawatt (or 1,000 kilowatts) of total electricity generating capacity.

2
Small-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) systems are electricity generators with less than one megawatt (MW) of electricity generating capacity, which are not connected at a power plant that has a combined capacity of one MW or larger.
